run_evaluate_dst: run the evaluate script with target and predicted txt files to produce a json report
parse_flattened_results_from_file: parse a line-separated txt file of DST results into a structured python list
evaluate_from_flat_list: evaluate target and predicted DST flat lists and return an evaluation report dictionary
save_evaluation_report: save the evaluation report dictionary as a json file to a specified output path
parse_cli_arguments: parse command-line arguments for input target path, predicted path, and output report path
